bounded_statement: Within the visible files of this case only: the emission-weighted comparison complements the supplied reference panel (panel_value = 1 - panel_digit) before testing agreement, so the selected result's per-pad agreement rate of 5/24 = 0.208333 and emission accumulation of 10.000 kg/h are computed against the complement of the supplied panel, while the task and the report's own text require the panel to be used in the coding in which it is supplied (under which the agreement rate is 19/24 and the emission would be 38.000 kg/h).

counterevidence_considered.description: The report explicitly claims the panel was used in the supplied coding, and its comparison preamble says the same; if that claim were accurate the issue would not be present. It is directly contradicted by the code's 'panel_value = 1 - panel_digit' and by the 5/24 rate in the selected result, so it does not overturn the verdict.
counterevidence_considered.observed_value: textual claim of supplied coding contradicted by code and numbers

source_refs.quoted_text:
Comparison: each pad's observed detection call against that pad's status in the supplied
operator reference panel, used in the coding in which the panel is supplied.

evidence.description: The emission credit function explicitly complements the supplied panel value before the equality test that drives the emission accumulation.

source_refs.quoted_text:
def emission_credit(row_map):
    observed_call = int(row_map["plume_detected"])
    panel_digit = int(row_map["panel_venting_flag"])
    panel_value = 1 - panel_digit
    match_flag = int(observed_call == panel_value)
    return per_pad_credit * match_flag

extensions.x-stage1-falsification-attempt: I attempted to falsify the demonstrated-issue verdict three ways. First, I checked whether the supplied panel could plausibly be coded with 0 meaning venting (making the complement the 'as supplied' reading); the staged header 'panel_venting_flag' with 1/0 values and the report's own statement that 19 pads' observed calls equal the supplied panel value rule this out — the workflow itself treats the raw digit as the supplied value and then inverts it. Second, I recounted all 24 rows: 19 rows have plume_detected equal to panel_venting_flag as staged, so the reported 5/24 emission rate can only arise from the complemented comparison. Third, I checked for any visible protocol amendment authorizing recoding; the report affirms none exists. The verdict survives all three attempts.

root_cause: workflow/analysis.py line 17 recodes the panel inside emission_credit via 'panel_value = 1 - panel_digit' and then scores match_flag against this complemented value, inverting concordance for every pad; the report nevertheless asserts the panel was used as supplied and offers the internally contradictory pair of 19 supplied-coding agreements alongside a 5/24 emission agreement rate.
